ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (15) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form); blocks 1 had no website counterpart and were translated fresh.

The prose poem's monkey keeps Turgenev's breed name «уистити» (uistiti, 'ouistiti', a marmoset) and his diminutives («ручка», ruchka, 'little hand'; «глазенки», glazyonki, 'little eyes'). The attribution keeps the printed abbreviation «Ив.» ('Iv.'); the heading «II» marks this as the second reading of the week, after Schopenhauer's 'Union'.
